labels.shortDescription: Import: the chosen mapping no longer exists
labels.value: That import mapping no longer exists. Go back and choose one from the list.

labels.shortDescription: Import: the batch record has gone
labels.value: That import no longer exists. Start again from the Import tab.

labels.shortDescription: Import: refused because no column identifies anyone
labels.value: No column was matched to a name or an email. Check that the first row of your file is the header row, then set at least one column to a last name, a full name, an email, or an organization name.

labels.shortDescription: Import: refused because the file staged no rows
labels.value: This file has no rows to import. Check that it is not empty and that the first row is the header row.

labels.shortDescription: Import: commit refused before a dry run
labels.value: Run a dry run before you commit, so you can see what would happen first.

labels.shortDescription: Import: template asks for person accounts the org does not have
labels.value: This mapping stores people as person accounts, and this org does not have them. Change the mapping to store people as contacts.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: rejected for a missing last name
labels.value: Required value missing: last name. Map a last name or a full name column, or fill in the blank in your file.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: rejected because it describes nobody
labels.value: This row has no name, no email and no organization, so there is nothing to create or match.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: rejected because its values could not be read
labels.value: This row could not be read. Check the file for stray quotation marks or line breaks inside a value.

labels.shortDescription: Import error: a row's two people cannot be told apart
labels.value: The two people on this row have the same matching details and the same first name, so they cannot be told apart. Give each their own first name.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: its new person is on an earlier row that did not save
labels.value: An earlier row of this file names the same new person, and they could not be saved: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Import row: rejected because its organization did not save
labels.value: The organization on this row could not be saved, so the rest of the row was left alone.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: rejected with no message from the platform
labels.value: This row could not be saved and Salesforce gave no reason.

labels.shortDescription: Import: refused because the user lacks Manage Nonprofit Settings
labels.value: You need the Manage Open Impact Settings permission to import. Ask whoever set up your org for the Open Impact Admin role.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: first line of a dry run
labels.value: Dry run. Nothing was written.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: first line of a commit
labels.value: Commit. Records were created and updated as shown.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: columns staged but not loaded, list of entities
labels.value: These columns were kept with each row but not loaded, because nothing in this org loads them yet: {0}.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: a mapped attribute the object does not have
labels.value: The mapping refers to {0}, which this org does not have. Those values were skipped.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: a mapped field the importing user cannot edit
labels.value: Not loaded: you do not have access to {0}. Those values were skipped. Ask your administrator for edit access to the field, then import the file again.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: a matching field the importing user cannot read
labels.value: Not matched on {0}: you do not have access to it, so nobody could be found by it, and a person your org holds only by that field counts as new. Ask your administrator for access to the field before you commit.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: a value the field would not take
labels.value: {0} would not accept the value "{1}". Those values were skipped.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: External ID rule with no external id field
labels.value: This org has no external identifier field, so nothing could be matched by external ID. Choose a different matching rule.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: the organization record type is missing
labels.value: The organization record type is missing, so no organization column was loaded.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: no person account record type
labels.value: This org has no person account record type, so no person was created.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: one chunk failed, with its number and reason
labels.value: Chunk {0} failed and its rows were rejected: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what the email rule does and risks
labels.value: Matches only when the email in your file is exactly the email on the record. The safest rule, and the one to start with.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what the name and postal code rule does and risks
labels.value: Matches on last name and postal code together. This will treat two different people who share a name at one address as the same person.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what the external id rule does and risks
labels.value: Matches on the external identifier your other system gave the record. The most reliable rule for a file you load every month, but only if your org has an external identifier field.

labels.shortDescription: Import journal: one change too large to record
labels.value: One change was too large to record in the import journal, so it cannot be put back by an undo.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: the journal could not be written
labels.value: Some changes this import made to existing records could not be recorded in its journal, so an undo will not put them back. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: a new household could not be tagged
labels.value: A household this import created could not be marked with the import, so an undo will not remove it: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: refused for a dry run
labels.value: This was a dry run, so it wrote nothing and there is nothing to undo.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: refused because already undone
labels.value: This import has already been undone, or is being undone now. Refresh the list to see where it has got to.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: refused before a commit
labels.value: Only an import that has been committed can be undone. Commit it, or leave it: a dry run changes nothing.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: refused after the deadline
labels.value: The time to undo this import ended on {0}. The records it created are ordinary records now; delete any you do not want by hand.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: nothing left to undo
labels.value: This import has nothing left to undo: no record still carries its mark and it changed no existing record.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: refused because the count changed
labels.value: You confirmed {0} records, but {1} now carry this import's mark. Nothing was deleted. Look at the new count and confirm again.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: kept, something was added since
labels.value: Kept: something recorded after the import points at this record, such as an activity or a relationship.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: kept, a person is still here
labels.value: Kept: a person the undo did not remove is still in this household or organization.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: kept for Nonprofit Cloud records
labels.value: Kept: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud records depend on this account.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: kept, could not be checked
labels.value: Kept: the undo could not check whether anything depends on this record, so it left it in place. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: kept, edited since
labels.value: Kept: somebody changed this record, or logged an activity on it, after the import.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: kept, no access to delete
labels.value: Kept: you do not have access to delete this record, so the undo left it in place.

labels.shortDescription: Import error: a run is already in progress
labels.value: This import is already running a dry run or a commit. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

labels.shortDescription: Import error: dry run after a commit
labels.value: This import has already been committed, so it cannot be run as a dry run again. Start a new import to preview the file.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: the undo line
labels.value: Undone by {0} on {1}: {2} records deleted, {3} kept, {4} values put back.

labels.value: Not put back: this value has been changed since the import.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo journal: a value that can no longer be written
labels.value: Not put back: the record or its field no longer exists, or cannot be edited.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: a recurring file needs a source name
labels.value: Give this file a source name, for example Monthly processor export, so the Hub can tell it apart from your other regular files.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: mark the mapping as a regular file
labels.value: This file arrives regularly

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what marking a file recurring does
labels.value: The Open Impact home page lists regular files with the date each was last imported. Nothing is loaded automatically.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the name of a regular file
labels.value: Source name

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: an Excel file that cannot be read
labels.value: Open Impact cannot read this Excel file. It may be an older .xls file or protected by a password. Save it as .xlsx or CSV and upload that.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the browser cannot open workbooks
labels.value: This browser cannot open Excel files. Save the sheet as CSV and upload that, or use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: an Excel file too large to open
labels.value: This Excel file is too large to open in the browser: it has more than 500,000 rows or 1,000 columns, or a sheet over 100 MB. Save the sheet as CSV and upload that.

labels.shortDescription: Import: expected row count below zero
labels.value: The expected number of rows cannot be less than zero.

labels.shortDescription: Import: commit refused, control totals differ
labels.value: This file does not match the control totals you entered. The run log gives both numbers. Correct the file or the control totals, then run a new dry run.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: row control total agrees
labels.value: Control total: the file has {0} rows, as expected.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: row control total differs
labels.value: Control total: the file has {0} rows, but {1} were expected. A commit is refused until they agree.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: amount control total agrees
labels.value: Control total: the file's gift amounts add up to {0}, as expected.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: amount control total differs
labels.value: Control total: the file's gift amounts add up to {0}, but {1} was expected. A commit is refused until they agree.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: amount control total not checked
labels.value: Control total: nothing in this org reads gift amounts, so the expected amount cannot be checked and a commit is refused. Clear the expected amount to continue.

labels.shortDescription: Import: wizard options could not be read
labels.value: The import settings sent with this file could not be read. Reload the page and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: control totals heading
labels.value: Control totals (optional)

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what control totals do
labels.value: From your deposit slip or your processor's report. The dry run checks the file against them, and a commit waits until they agree. Leave them empty to skip the check.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: expected row count label
labels.value: Rows in the file

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: expected gift total label
labels.value: Total of the gift amounts

labels.shortDescription: Import error: donation matching choice unknown
labels.value: Choose how gifts are matched: Match or create, Always create, Match only or Never match.

labels.shortDescription: Import error: donation matching window or tolerance below zero
labels.value: The days either side and the amount difference allowed cannot be less than zero, and the days cannot be more than 999.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching heading
labels.value: Scheduled payments

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching help
labels.value: When a gift pays a pledge or a recurring gift the donor already has, Open Impact can link the two. Leave the numbers empty to use Open Impact Settings.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching choice label
labels.value: Matching gifts to scheduled payments

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching option Match or create
labels.value: Match or create: pay the payment it matches, or create it on its own

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching option Always create
labels.value: Always create: never look for payments

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching option Match only
labels.value: Match only: reject a gift that matches no payment

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching option Never match
labels.value: Never match: reject a gift that matches a payment or a gift you already have

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching date window label
labels.value: Days either side of a payment's due date

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: donation matching amount tolerance label
labels.value: Amount difference allowed
